audit_items.title: Do coset_for_cell elements form a valid coset h*G with correct generator order?
audit_items.reason: SPECIFICATION-ONLY: coset_for_cell is a specification function from EIP-7594 (Fulu upgrade). Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement these mathematical primitives directly - they are handled by external cryptographic libraries (e.g., go-kzg-4844). This is not part of the Prysm bug bounty scope.

audit_items.title: Is the receipt encoding type prefix byte correctly matched to transaction type?
audit_items.reason: COMPONENT MISMATCH: Receipt encoding is an Execution Layer (EL) concern, not Consensus Layer (CL). Prysm is a CL client and does not handle transaction receipt encoding - this is handled by EL clients like geth or nethermind. This is not part of the Prysm bug bounty scope.
